y-m-70-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uhambe ngephutha. I-directrix ngu-x=−3 futhi amaphoyinti egophweni lepharabola anawo x≥0, ngakho u-P usesokudleni se-directrix. Ngakho ibanga phakathi kuka-P ne-directrix alingu-x−3 kodwa ngu-x−(−3)=x+3. Ukulungisa kunika x+3=9, x=6, y²=72, ngakho P(6, 6√2) noma P(6, −6√2). Imigqa 4 no-5 iyiziphumo ezithole iphutha lomugqa 3.
y-m-70-01.s.s2.prompt: Iyiphi indlela eyisiza kakhulu yokuqinisekisa ukuthi impendulo kaMinjae u-P(12, 12) akuyona impendulo yenkinga?

y-m-70-01.s.s2.o.c: Bala ibanga phakathi kuka-P(12, 12) no-F(3, 0) ubone ukuthi lingu-9 yini

y-m-70-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ku-y²=12x, thola amanani luka-x anjengo-x=3, 12, 27 lapho u-12x eyisikwele esiphelele, bese uthola u-y.
y-m-70-01.s.s3.hint.1: Yenza isikwele samahlukaniso ezixhumanisi zephoyinti owalithola no-F(3, 0), ubangeze, uthathe impande yesikwele, bese uqhathanisa no-x+3.

y-m-70-01.s.s3.explain: Isibonelo, ku-(3, 6), u-d=6=3+3; ku-(12, 12), u-d=15=12+3; ku-(27, 18), u-d=30=27+3. Kuwo wonke amaphoyinti u-PF=x+3 uqinisekisiwe. Ngakho u-PF=9 wenzeka kuphela ku-x=6, bese u-y²=72, ngakho izimpendulo zale nkinga akuyona amaphoyinti anezixhumanisi eziyizinombolo eziphelele.

y-m-70-09.title: Uma ilayini lihlangana nepharabola endaweni eyodwa, liyi-tangent?
y-m-70-09.prereq.0: Cabanga ukuthi umfundi uthatha inkambo yokukhetha ye-high-school 'Geometry'. I-'H2' iyizinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kwalesi sabelo sokukhiqiza kuphela; ayisho ukuthi uMnyango Wezemfundo unikeza le nkambo ebangeni elithile.
y-m-70-09.topic: Izingxenye zekoni: izindawo ze-parabola nomugqa, imigqa eyithanjeniti
y-m-70-09.goal: Hlulela isitatimende esithi "uma ihlangana endaweni eyodwa, iyithanjeniti" usebenzisa ubufakazi etafuleni bese ufuna isibonelo esiphikisayo, yakha wena amapheya (m, n) anikeza imigqa eyithanjeniti ye-parabola, bese uchaza icala i-discriminant engakwazi ukuhlukanisa.
y-m-70-09.material:
Kukhona i-parabola C: y²=4x nomugqa l_m: y=mx+1 (m inombolo yangempela). (y² ifundwa ngokuthi "y squared".) U-Jisu uthe, "Umugqa ohlangana ne-parabola endaweni eyodwa kuphela uyimugqa wethanjeniti." Imiphumela yokufaka umugqa esibalweni se-C nokulula, namaphoyinti okuhlangana, angezansi.
m | isibalo ngemva kokufaka | ukuhlangana
−1 | x²−6x+1=0 | amaphoyinti amabili
0 | −4x+1=0 | iphoyinti elilodwa (1/4, 1)
1 | x²−2x+1=0 | iphoyinti elilodwa (1, 2)
2 | 4x²+1=0 | akukho
Sikhumbuzo: Ithanjeniti endaweni (x₁, y₁) ku-C ngu-y₁·y=2(x+x₁) (ifomula yethanjeniti).
y-m-70-09.thinking.1: Ukusetha isimo sethanjeniti nokwakha izibonelo eziningana
y-m-70-09.prereq.1: Ithanjeniti y₁y=2(x+x₁) endaweni (x₁, y₁) ku-parabola y²=4x
y-m-70-09.s.s1.prompt: Hlulela isitatimende sika-Jisu usebenzisa ithebula nesikhumbuzo njengobufakazi.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.hint.0: Emigqeni emibili etafuleni ehlangana endaweni eyodwa (m=0, m=1), thola ithanjeniti endaweni ngayinye yokuhlangana ngefomula yethanjeniti bese uyiqhathanisa nalowo mugqa.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.hint.1: Dweba isithombe bese uqhathanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uqondiswe kanjani uma uqhathaniswa nesimo se-parabola.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. Etafuleni, imigqa ehlangana endaweni eyodwa (m=0, m=1) yonke iyimigqa yethanjeniti
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.a: Awuhlolanga ukuthi umugqa ka-m=0 ufana yini nethanjeniti ku-(1/4, 1).
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.b: Akulungile. Umugqa ka-m=0 uhlangana endaweni eyodwa kodwa awuyona ithanjeniti.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sithole icala elilodwa eliphula isitatimende futhi sahlola nesizathu (sihluke ethanjeniti).
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.c: Noma ngabe kunemigqa emingaki, isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo siphula "uma ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela, iyithanjeniti".
y-m-70-09.s.s1.o.d: Akulungile. Ithanjeniti ihlala ihlangana ne-parabola emaphoyinteni amabili
y-m-70-09.s.s1.r.d: Lesi sinqumo sihluke encazelweni yokuthi ithanjeniti ithinta endaweni eyodwa.
y-m-70-09.s.s1.explain: Umugqa u-y=1 onelungelo lika-m=0 uhlangana no-C endaweni eyodwa (1/4, 1), kodwa ithanjeniti kuleyo ndawo ngu-y=2x+1/2, ngakho ihluke ku-y=1. Umugqa u-y=1 uhambisana ne-axis (i-x-axis) ye-parabola, ngakho noma uhlangana endaweni eyodwa, awuyona ithanjeniti. Isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo senza isitatimende sika-Jisu singalungi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, u-m=1 ufana nethanjeniti u-y=x+1, ngakho iyithanjeniti.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amapheya angu-3 (m, n), anama-m ahlukene, lapho umugqa u-y=mx+n uyithanjeniti ku-parabola y²=4x. (Khipha imigqa ehambisana ne-axis neyohlobo lika-x=k. Ungasebenzisa amadesimali.)
y-m-70-09.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-y=mx+n ku-y²=4x bese wenza isisho ku-x. Ingabe sine-quadratic?
y-m-70-09.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi isimo sini sezixazululo zalesi sibalo sihambelana nokuba ithanjeniti, bese usetha isibalo usebenzisa i-discriminant.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Uma m=0, umugqa uhambisana ne-axis ye-parabola, ngakho awuyona ithanjeniti.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Faka u-y=mx+n ku-y²=4x wenze isibalo se-quadratic ku-x, bese uhlola isimo sokuthi sibe nempande ephindwe kabili.
y-m-70-09.s.s2.explain: Ukuhlela kabusha (mx+n)²=4x kunikeza m²x²+(2mn−4)x+n²=0, futhi kusuka ku-discriminant (2mn−4)²−4m²n²=16−16mn=0 sithola mn=1. Okungukuthi, y=mx+1/m (m≠0) iyithanjeniti. Izibonelo: (1, 1), (2, 1/2), (−1, −1). x=0 (i-y-axis) ayiwuhlobo lika-y=mx+n, kodwa iyithanjeniti ku-vertex.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.prompt: Kumugqa ofana no-y=1 ohlangana ne-parabola endaweni eyodwa kodwa ongeyona ithanjeniti, uphikisana kanjani nendlela yokuhlola isimo sethanjeniti nge-discriminant ngemva kokufaka? Chaza kafushane.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi isisho esifakiwe −4x+1=0 sinezinga elingakanani uma m=0.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isisho kumele sibe nezinga elingakanani ukuze i-discriminant ikwazi ukukhuluma ngo-"mpande ephindwe kabili".
y-m-70-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngishilo ukuthi uma m=0 kuyisisho se-linear, hhayi se-quadratic?
y-m-70-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngicabange ngokuthi kungani umugqa ohambisana ne-axis ukhethekile kuphela ku-parabola?
y-m-70-09.s.s3.model.0: Uma m=0, isisho esifakiwe siyi-linear futhi sinesixazululo esisodwa kuphela. Kuleli cala awukwazi ukusebenzisa i-discriminant ukufuna impande ephindwe kabili, futhi lo mugqa uhambisana ne-axis, ngakho noma uhlangana endaweni eyodwa, awuyona ithanjeniti.
y-m-70-09.s.s3.model.1: I-discriminant engu-0 isho ukuthi isibalo se-quadratic sinempande ephindwe kabili, ngakho umugqa uyithanjeniti. Umugqa ohambisana ne-axis unikeza isisho se-linear, ngakho isimo se-discriminant asisebenzi, kodwa uhlangana endaweni eyodwa. Ngakho ukuhlangana endaweni eyodwa akuwenzi uthanjeniti.

y-m-70-03.title: Ingabe umugqa onokuthambeka okufanayo ne-asymptote awuhlangani nhlobo ne-hyperbola?
y-m-70-03.topic: Izingxenye zekhoni: izindawo ze-asymptotes ze-hyperbola nomugqa
y-m-70-03.goal: Hlola ukuhlanganisa okwakhiwe ngokufaka i-asymptote eyodwa kuyimigqa eminingi, uguqule isahlulelo sakho, bese usebenzisa umphumela ukwakha wena izibonelo zemigqa enokuthambeka okufanayo.
y-m-70-03.material: Ama-asymptote e-hyperbola u-H: x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 (funda: x squared over 4 minus y squared over 9 equals 1) angu-y=(3/2)x no-y=−(3/2)x. USoyoung wathi: “Umugqa onokuthambeka okufanayo ne-asymptote awuhlangani nhlobo no-H. I-asymptote isondela kuphela ku-H ingayithinti.” Asihlolisise lokho uSoyoung akushilo ngokubheka izinto ezingezansi eyodwa ngesikhathi.
y-m-70-03.prereq.2: Ukufaka i-equation yomugqa ku-equation ye-hyperbola nokwenza lula
y-m-70-03.s.s1.prompt: Ngokubheka izinto isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, khetha isahlulelo sakho samanje ngalokho uSoyoung akushilo.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuthi lokho okuqinisekisiwe kuze kube manje yi-'asymptote uqobo lwayo' yini noma yimigqa yonke enokuthambeka okufanayo.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka ngqo umugqa owodwa onokuthambeka okufanayo kodwa ongeyona i-asymptote, njengo-y=(3/2)x+1.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Ukufaka i-asymptote u-y=(3/2)x ku-equation luka-H kunika u-x²/4 − ((3/2)x)²/9 = x²/4 − x²/4 = 0, okungu-0 noma u-x uyini. Akunakuba ngu-1, ngakho i-asymptote ayihlangani no-H.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uma usubonile lesi sinto, siyini isahlulelo sakho ngalokho uSoyoung akushilo (wonke umugqa onokuthambeka okufanayo awuhlangani nhlobo no-H)?
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi i-asymptote uqobo lwayo ayihlangani no-H. Kodwa lokho uSoyoung akushilo kumayelana nayo yonke imigqa enokuthambeka okufanayo, ngakho eminye imigqa ayikahlolwa.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ngicabanga ukuthi kulungile, kodwa i-asymptote eyodwa kuphela ehloliwe, ngakho ukuzethemba kwami kuyabuthakathaka
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqinisekisile ukuthi i-asymptote uqobo lwayo ayihlangani no-H. Awukahloli eminye imigqa enokuthambeka okufanayo.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kusenesikhathi sokuhlulela. Eminye imigqa enokuthambeka okufanayo nayo kumele ihlolwe
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Isitatimende simayelana 'nayo yonke imigqa enokuthambeka okufanayo'. Uyazi ukuthi umugqa obonwe kuze kube manje munye kuphela kuyo.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Akulungile. Wonke umugqa onokuthambeka okufanayo uhlangana no-H
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lokhu akuvumelani nento yokuthi i-asymptote ayihlangani. Kuyisahlulelo esimenyezelwe ohlangothini oluphambene ngaphandle kobufakazi.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ukufaka umugqa u-y=(3/2)x+1, onokuthambeka okufanayo, ku-equation luka-H kunika u-x²/4 − ((3/2)x+1)²/9 = −x/3 − 1/9 = 1. Ngakho u-x=−10/3, u-y=(3/2)(−10/3)+1=−4, futhi uhlangana no-H ephoyintini elingu-(−10/3, −4). (Hlola: (100/9)/4 − 16/9 = 25/9 − 16/9 = 1)
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uma usubonile lesi sinto esisha, siyini isahlulelo sakho ngalokho uSoyoung akushilo?
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Iphoyinti elingu-(−10/3, −4) lanelisa i-equation luka-H ne-equation yomugqa, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo. Isibonelo esiphikisayo esisodwa senza ukuhlanganisa kukaSoyoung kube yiphutha.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ukubala kumele kube iphutha. Uma ukuthambeka kufana ne-asymptote, azikwazi ukuhlangana
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lesi isahlulelo esizama ukugcina inkolelo yokuqala ngaphandle kokwenza wena ukubala kokuhlola (ukuthi iphoyinti lanelisa yini i-equation luka-H).
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lo mugqa awukwazi ukuba yisibonelo esiphikisayo ngoba awunokuthambeka okufanayo ne-asymptote
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuthambeka ku-y=(3/2)x+1 ngu-3/2, okufanayo ne-asymptote. Hlola futhi isimo sokuba yisibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Isitatimende sikaSoyoung siyiphutha. Kukhona umugqa onokuthambeka okufanayo othi uhlangane no-H
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lesi isahlulelo sokuthi isibonelo esiphikisayo esisodwa sephule 'uma ukuthambeka kufana, awuhlangani nhlobo'.

y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Umugqa onokuthambeka okufanayo uhlangana njalo no-H emaphoyintini angu-2
y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukuze kuvele amaphoyinti angu-2, i-equation efakiwe kumele ibe yi-quadratic equation. Esintweni esingenhla, i-equation yayiqondile.

y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uchazile wonke amacala ngokuhlukanisa u-k=0 no-k≠0.

y-m-70-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wathatha umphumela ohloliwe ngezinyathelo ezingu-2 njengephutha.

y-m-70-05.title: Uma usika inkabi ngendiza, i-cross-section ihlala iyindilinga?
y-m-70-05.topic: Ama-coordinate esikhala: isibalo senkabi ne-cross-section yayo ngendiza z=k
y-m-70-05.goal: Usebenzisa idatha ye-cross-section enikezwe ethebuleni njengobufakazi, hlulela isitatimende 'i-cross-section yenkabi ihlala iyindilinga', thola izindiza ezinika izindilinga ezine-radius yenombolo ephelele, bese uchaza ukuthi usayizi we-cross-section uncike kanjani endaweni.
y-m-70-05.material:
Inkabi S: (x−1)²+(y−2)²+(z−3)²=25 (maphakathi (1, 2, 3), i-radius 5) isikwa yindiza z=k. UEunho uthe, “I-cross-section yenkabi ihlala iyindilinga,” futhi wenze ithebula elingezansi lamanani ambalwa ka-k. (k; wonke ubude buyunithi efanayo)
k | isibalo sokuhlangana | isimo se-cross-section
3 | (x−1)²+(y−2)²=25 | indilinga maphakathi (1, 2, 3), i-radius 5
0 | (x−1)²+(y−2)²=16 | indilinga maphakathi (1, 2, 0), i-radius 4
8 | (x−1)²+(y−2)²=0 | iphoyinti elilodwa (1, 2, 8)
9 | (x−1)²+(y−2)²=−11 | akukho maphoyinti okuhlangana

y-m-70-07.title: Ukulungisa indawo eyenziwe iphoyinti ngaphakathi konxantathu ngama-coefficient
y-m-70-07.topic: Ama-vector endiza: inhlanganisela eyisilayini AP=sAB+tAC nendawo yonxantathu
y-m-70-07.goal: Thola wena ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-coefficient eliphoyinti elibhalwe njengenhlanganisela eyisilayini yama-vector nezindawo zonxantathu, yenza amaphoyinti amaningana afeza umbandela wendawo, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani imibandela emibili yendawo inquma iphoyinti elilodwa.
y-m-70-07.material: Kunonxantathu ABC (amaphoyinti amathathu akho emugqeni owodwa), futhi iphoyinti P libhalwa njengo-AP = s·AB + t·AC. (AP, AB no-AC ngama-vector, futhi s no-t izinombolo zangempela. Funda ngokuthi 'vector AP ilingana no-s izikhathi vector AB kwengeziwe t izikhathi vector AC'.) Cabanga ngecala lapho iphoyinti P liphakathi konxantathu ABC.

y-m-70-07.s.s1.r.c: Lo mbono wokubheka ukuthi ukuphakama kusukela ku-P kuya emugqeni AB kuyizikhathi ezingaki zokuphakama kusukela ku-C kuya emugqeni AB.
y-m-70-07.s.s1.r.d: Ukuthi uhamba kangakanani ohlangothini lwe-AB akushintshi ukuphakama kuya emugqeni AB.
y-m-70-07.s.s1.explain: Ku-P=A+s·AB+t·AC, ukuhamba ngo-s ohlangothini lwe-AB akushintshi ukuphakama kuya emugqeni AB, futhi ukuhamba ngo-t ohlangothini lwe-AC kwenza ukuphakama kube izikhathi ezingu-t zokuphakama kuka-C. Njengoba isisekelo AB siyafana, (indawo yonxantathu PAB) : (indawo yonxantathu ABC)=t : 1. Ngesizathu esifanayo PAC ingu-s izikhathi futhi PBC ingu-1−s−t izikhathi.

y-m-70-08.material: Kunephaneli yelanga eyisikwele enohlangothi olungu-6 m. Ibekwe nohlangothi olulodwa luhambisana nomhlabathi (ngokuvundlile), futhi iphaneli iyashutheka ezungeze lolo hlangothi; bita i-engeli eyenza nomhlabathi ngo-θ. y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.c: I-semi-major axis ibanga elisuka maphakathi liye ku-vertex. Iyinani elihlukile ebangeni elisuka ku-focus liye ephoyintini le-ellipse.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.d: Kubukeka sengathi ubeke ubude 10 be-major axis bulingana nokwehluka kwamabanga amabili, hhayi isamba.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.explain: Ubude be-major axis bungu-10, ngakho u-PF+PF′=10. U-PF ungu-5−4=1 ku-vertex eseduze kakhulu futhi u-5+4=9 ku-vertex ekude kakhulu, ngakho angathatha wonke amanani phakathi kuka-1 no-9. U-7 ungaphakathi kwalobo bubanzi, bese u-PF′=10−7=3.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.prompt: Ku-ellipse efanayo, yenza ama-ordered pair angu-3 (p, q) lapho empeleni kukhona iphoyinti u-P elinguPF=p no-PF′=q. (Ukushintshanisa u-p no-q kubalwa njengesibonelo esifanayo. Ungasebenzisa ama-decimal.)
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi u-p+q kumele ube yini, bese uhlola ukuthi ukukhetha u-p oyedwa kunquma yini u-q.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.1: Zama u-p ongaphansi kuka-1 noma ophezulu kuno-9 bese ucabanga ukuthi iphoyinti elinjalo lingaba empeleni ku-ellipse yini.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Isamba samabanga amabili singu-10, ubude be-major axis.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c1: U-p+q akusiyo u-10. Isamba samabanga aya kuma-focus amabili alesi ellipse sasiyini?
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c2: Ungaphakathi kobubanzi bamabanga iphoyinti le-ellipse elingaba nawo.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Ibanga elisuka ephoyintini le-ellipse liye ku-focus alikwazi ukuba ngaphansi kuka-1. Khumbula ibanga ku-vertex eseduze kakhulu.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.explain: U-p+q=10, futhi inani luka-PF liqala ku-1 (vertex eseduze) liye ku-9 (vertex ekude), ngakho u-p no-q bobabili kumele babe okungenani u-1. Wonke ama-ordered pair anika u-p phakathi kuka-1 no-9, njengo-(3, 7), (5, 5) no-(1, 9), ayenzeka.

y-m-70-04.title: Uma ama-dot product alingana, ingabe ama-vector amabili nawo ayalingana?
y-m-70-04.prereq.0: Cabanga ukuthi umfundi uthatha inkambo yokukhetha ye-high-school 'Geometry'. I-'H2' iyizinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kwalesi sabelo sokukhiqiza kuphela; ayisho ukuthi uMnyango Wezemfundo unikeza le nkambo ebangeni elithile.
y-m-70-04.topic: Ama-vector asendaweni eyisicaba: izimfanelo ze-dot product nezibonelo eziphikisayo
y-m-70-04.goal: Hlola ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi umthetho wokuqeda osebenza ezinombolweni ('uma u-ab=ac futhi u-a≠0 khona-ke u-b=c') usebenza yini nakwi-dot product yama-vector, bese ukhetha izimo ezenza usebenze.
y-m-70-04.material: Ezinombolweni, uma u-a≠0 futhi u-ab=ac, khona-ke u-b=c. UJeonghyeok wacabanga ukuthi ama-vector asebenza ngendlela efanayo futhi wathi: “Uma u-a=(2, 1), uma u-a·b=a·c khona-ke u-b=c.” (U-a·b yi-dot product luka-a no-b, okungukuthi inani olithola ngokuphindaphinda izingxenye bese uzengeza. Wonke ama-vector asendaweni yokuxhumanisa eyisicaba.)
y-m-70-04.thinking.0: Ukungabaza ukuthi umthetho wezinombolo ungaguqulelwa ezintweni ezinye yini
y-m-70-04.thinking.1: Ukwakha wena isibonelo esiphikisayo esanelisa izimo
y-m-70-04.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ukuthi izimo ezengeziwe zanele yini
y-m-70-04.prereq.1: Uhlobo lwezingxenye lwama-vector asendaweni eyisicaba ne-dot product u-a·b=a₁b₁+a₂b₂
y-m-70-04.prereq.2: Izimfanelo ze-dot product uma ama-vector amabili ehambisana noma emi nkabi
y-m-70-04.s.s1.prompt: Ukuze wazi ukuthi isitatimende sikaJeonghyeok sihlala sisebenza yini, yimaphi (b, c) angaba wusizo kakhulu ukuwahlola?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.0: Uma isitatimende sinefomu elithi 'uma isimo khona-ke isiphetho', isibonelo esisiphula kumele sinelise yini futhi siphule yini, isimo noma isiphetho?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ngokukhetha i-vector eyodwa okwaziwa i-dot product yayo no-a=(2, 1), bese ushintsha izingxenye zayo bese ufuna enye i-vector i-dot product yayo ihlala injalo.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.a: Hlola amapheya amaningi lapho u-b no-c beyi-vector efanayo
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.a: Uma u-b=c, u-a·b=a·c uhlala ewuqiniso. Lawa akuwona amapheya angaphula isitatimende.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.b: Hlola kuphela ama-vector anesiqondiso esifanayo no-a
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.b: Uhlola icala elikhethekile kuphela. Noma lisebenza lapho, awukwazi ukwazi ngamanye amacala.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.c: Usayizi awunalo uhlobo oluqondile nokuthi lesi sitatimende sisebenza yini.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.d: Funa amapheya anika u-a·b=a·c futhi u-b≠c
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.d: Njengoba isitatimende sithi 'njalo', lo mcabango ufuna ipheya elanelisa isimo kodwa liphikisana nesiphetho.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.explain: Isitatimende se-'njalo' siphulwa yipheya eyodwa elanelisa isimo (a·b=a·c) kodwa liphikisana nesiphetho (b=c). Ngakho into eyisiza kakhulu ukufuna ipheya enjalo wena.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.prompt: Ku-a=(2, 1), yenza amapheya angu-2 ama-vector u-b=(b₁, b₂), c=(c₁, c₂) anika u-a·b=a·c kodwa u-b≠c. Amapheya amabili kumele abe nama-b−c ahlukile (ukushintshanisa u-b no-c, noma ukushintsha uphawu luka-b−c kuphela, kubalwa njengesibonelo esifanayo).
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokukhetha u-b oyedwa bese ubala u-a·b.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi u-a·c ushintsha kangakanani uma ushintsha ingxenye eyodwa luka-c, bese ushintsha enye ingxenye ngendlela efanele ukubuyisela i-dot product.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Bala u-a·b=2b₁+b₂ no-a·c=2c₁+c₂ ngokuhlukile. Amanani amabili awalingani.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c2: b no-c iyi-vector efanayo. Kufanele zihluke ukuze zibe yisibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo: uma b=(1, 3), c=(2, 1), khona-ke a·b=2+3=5 no-a·c=4+1=5 ayalingana kodwa b≠c. b−c ihlala iphuma ngefomu (t, −2t), isiqondiso esiqondile ku-a. Ngakho ungahambisa i-vector ngenani elithile noma yiliphi ohlangothini oluqondile ku-a.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.prompt: Uqinisekise ukuthi isitatimende asihlali sibamba. Khetha zonke imibandela eyengeziwe elandelayo eyenza 'uma a·b=a·c khona-ke b=c' ibambe. (a akuyona i-vector ka-zero.)
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala kabusha umbandela ngamunye njengokuthi b−c kufanele ibe yi-vector yohlobo luni. a·(b−c)=0 isho ini?
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kumbandela ngamunye, funa ngqo ipheya elinama-b≠c uma a=(2, 1). Uma ulithola, lowo mbandela awanele.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba nosayizi ofanayo akwenzi ama-vector abe afanayo. Hlola ukuthi b=(1, 3), c=(3, −1) ifeza umbandela uma a=(2, 1).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.b: a·b=a·c iyabamba kuwo wonke ama-vector a endizeni
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.b: Lo mbono ushintsha a ngenkathi ubeka umbandela ukuze b−c iqonde kuzo zonke iziqondiso.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.c: Uphuthelwe ukuthi kunama-vector angenakubalwa aqonde ku-a emugqeni owodwa. Isibonelo, cabanga ngo-(1, −2) no-(2, −4).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.d: Lo mbono usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi ama-vector emugqeni owodwa anqunywa ngamunye ngosayizi wawo (umphumela we-dot).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.explain: Njengoba a·(b−c)=0, kwanele ukuthi b−c iqonde ku-a. (b) Uma ibamba kuwo wonke a, khona-ke b−c iqonde kuzo zonke iziqondiso, ngakho iyi-vector ka-zero. (d) Uma b=sa no-c=ta, khona-ke s|a|²=t|a|² inika s=t. (a) Uma b=(1, 3), c=(3, −1), osayizi bayalingana futhi a·b=a·c=5, kodwa b≠c. (c) (1, −2) no-(2, −4) kokubili kuqonde ku-a ngakho umphumela wabo we-dot ungu-0, kodwa bahlukile komunye nomunye.
